one_line_thought: 地図は、niche を薄くする。
priority_rule: prefer a public complete or near-complete native event stream over a final outcome-filtered analysis table
prefer x-y and organism z/t recorded on the same sensor event
prefer explicit regular or reconstructable sensor schedule/effort semantics
prefer unrounded or source-precision spatial coordinates when biologically safe and publicly archived
prefer raw/outlier flags retained so structural preflight does not depend on undocumented upstream filtering

candidates.source_architecture_notes: GPS locations include horizontal position and GPS altitude on the same location event; archived package contains departure/return sections of 79 trips rather than the complete foraging tracks.
architecture_priority_notes: archive is a preselected commuting-track subset rather than the most complete native event stream

candidates.source_architecture_notes: GPS tags recorded latitude, longitude and height above sea level together at approximately 30 s intervals. Source documentation states that all data, including points marked as outliers and removed from the published analysis, are archived.
architecture_priority_notes: all archived fixes including upstream outliers are retained

candidates.source_architecture_notes: Each public row is one GPS flight fix with timestamp, latitude, longitude, height above ground and vertical uncertainty. However, the public repository contains only the final 237-flight analysis table; raw GPS downloads and upstream cleaning/filtering are absent, and coordinates are rounded to two decimals.
architecture_priority_notes: same-event x-y-z-t is present in the final table
final table is outcome-filtered to flight fixes
raw GPS and upstream filter denominator are not public in the archive
public coordinates are rounded to approximately 1 km

selection_reason: Among candidates passing architecture admission, this lane has the strongest source-only combination of native same-event x-y-z, regular effort semantics, a public versioned archive, and retention of the complete archived event stream including points excluded by the source analysis. Selection does not use an ODSP thickness value or a z-distribution.
next_boundary: Freeze a bat-specific structural preflight and empirical contract before reading altitude distributions or any ODSP outcome.
